profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Pluralsight
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer with over 4.5 years of experience at Pluralsight, I maintain seven microservices across a full-stack architecture, utilizing Node.js, TypeScript, and C# (Express, ASP.NET Core), React/Svelte frontends, and PostgreSQL/Redis-backed data layers. I have contributed to the early adoption of an internal design system, led accessibility compliance efforts to align with WCAG 2.2 AAA standards, and implemented an AI-assisted workflow using Claude Code to address a critical security backlog.

My work is driven by a commitment to building scalable systems and fostering confident, cohesive teams. I excel in identifying bottlenecks, streamlining cross-team processes, and addressing challenges with direct, effective solutions. My focus is on creating robust, accessible, and secure digital systems that empower users and organizations.

With hundreds of unique board games to choose from, I assist in game selection, teaching rules and strategies, and fostering social interaction.

positions.title: Research Student
positions.description: Synthesized heavy metal/organic material compounds engineered to absorb and transfer energy as light, then cooled solutions with liquid nitrogen to capture precise emission measurements, establishing solution stability for research validation.

positions.title: Unit Director
positions.description: Unit Director for an overnight respite camp, overseeing full-time care for campers with developmental disabilities, across numerous weekend sessions. Led training for incoming counselors and managed a cabin unit of 15-30 campers with a team of 10-15 counselors — coordinating break schedules, monitoring engagement, and maintaining a consistent balance of safety and enjoyment throughout each session. Served as the primary point of escalation for medical and behavioral incidents beyond counselor scope, addressed specialized parent/guardian concerns, and acted as the key liaison between counselors and camp leadership.

projects.title: Campaign Communities
projects.description:
Campaign Communities is a project designed to provide collaborative note-taking for RPG campaigns, allowing every player to contribute their notes into a shared pool of information. While established RPG campaign management systems let a leader build extensive world libraries for players to explore, none offer a true joint note-taking option. My hope is that this fills that gap — helping groups reach a higher level of shared understanding than what any single player's notes could provide alone.

The project is hosted on AWS, with user-generated content stored in DynamoDB and served through AWS Lambda and API Gateway, which connect the database to the website. The frontend is built with React and Redux to manage the user experience across the site's various pages.
The project utilizes AWS to host the website, as well as Serve the content ,stored in DynamoDB, that is produced by the user. This utilizes AWS Lambda, and API Gateway to integrate the database and website.
The web page is built from React and Redux to manage the users experience while navigating the various relevant pages.

projects.title: NeuroMap.app
projects.description: The Neuromap.app project was initially built as a jumping-off point for my understanding of web applications. I worked alongside a senior-level engineer who guided me on best practices and relevant design decisions where appropriate. While this was a great learning opportunity, I felt the project had reached the end of its usefulness to me, as I was eager to continue my learning in other technologies, particularly cloud infrastructure.
